reviews.feedback: internal/api/customers.go, importCustomers (the io.ReadAll / http.MaxBytesReader call with importMaxBytes = 10 << 20): the task sets the limits as 10,000 data records (413 too_many_rows) and nothing about body bytes. A valid import of 10,000 records with metadata columns can exceed 10 MiB and is then rejected with 413 "too_large", a code the spec does not define. A 10,001-record file with long rows gets the wrong code too. Fix: drop the byte cap, or set a generous cap that cannot be reached by 10,000 records and return too_many_rows when it is hit. Add a test with 10,000 records whose rows are long enough to pass the current cap, expecting 201 or 200 dry run, and a 10,001-record file expecting too_many_rows.
